instructions.runner: No pre-supplied production-branch runner is expected. Implement the narrow captured-call adapter from the bound SGLang sources and the two seed scripts inside this project.
instructions.owner: Create one controller-host detached outer owner with unit_manager pid. It owns the pool claim, heartbeats, repair coordination, retrieval, and release; it may invoke SSH. Any guest worker must be recorded as unit_manager remote-shell, never pid.
instructions.first_paid_evidence: The first claimed-GPU action is the exact real c32 Q12 two-stage captured-call component already specified by DIRECTOR_PRODUCTION_BRANCH_REPAIR.json.
instructions.return_boundary: Do not return after source discovery or runner absence. Return only after launching the durable controller-host owner, or after persisting a typed terminal from a real compile or consumer attempt that makes the admitted intervention impossible.
instructions.repair: An ordinary import, staging, compile, audit, server, or retrieval defect uses the shared repair handshake while the same claim remains heartbeating.
